traditional: the Moon opposition Jupiter: a hard contact. The body, home, and daily needs works against growth, fortune, and patronage - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas.
modern: Feelings meet optimism and expansion. A resilient inner buoyancy that recovers no matter what, plus real generosity. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Emotional and physical excess; overindulgence and overcommitment. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

readerCopy.body: The public appeal says there is enough support to go around while the people distributing it describe shortages and impossible choices. Moon opposite Jupiter puts the headline total directly against rent, food, beds, time, and the daily limits of care. Money raised is not the same as help delivered. Follow the resources all the way to the people using them. If local workers are still deciding whose need can be met first, the campaign is not finished just because the fundraising goal was reached.
